events.summary: Speaker C reported the prototype base is gunmetal grey, as decided, and made of plastic.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: The base is gonna be gunmetal gray, which is what we had decided

events.summary: Speaker C reported the latex cover is red on the prototype, and is replaceable.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: then there's the latex cover, which is what you see as red

events.summary: Speaker C reported the buttons are a much lighter, almost see-through pale blue.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: the buttons will be a l much lighter blue, almost see-through

events.summary: Speaker C reported the whole remote lights up yellow when any button is pressed.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: The whole thing lights up if you press any button

events.summary: Speaker C reported the side buttons are one button each that push up and down.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: They're one button, but they kind of push up and down

events.summary: Speaker C reported the bottom logo is bright yellow with the R_R_ mark.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: bright yellow sort of design with the R_R_ which will actually look like our logo

events.summary: Speaker B reported the two square buttons are menu and mute, the least used, with numbers, channel and volume.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the two squared buttons are are two probably least used, menu, mute

events.summary: Speaker A decided on a single curve for the bottom of the remote, since it is not big enough to need a double curve.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Single sounds good, 'cause it's not big enough to really constitute a double

events.summary: Speaker A first said six for easy to use, then the group corrected it and rated easy to use as two out of seven.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Um easy to use. I vote six.

events.summary: Speaker A reported the fashionable score averaged 2.5 out of 7, after Speaker C gave three or four and Speaker A gave one.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Two or three. Two point five.

events.summary: Speaker A said the prototype is very ergonomically designed, and the feels-good scores averaged about two out of seven.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it is very ergonomically designed. It's gonna be curved

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a score of three out of seven for technologically innovative, because the remote only covers the TV.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: so I'd probably give it a three

events.summary: Speaker A settled the technologically innovative score at three and a half out of seven, after Speaker C gave four.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: let's go for a three point five

events.summary: Speaker D gave a score of two out of seven for the squishy and fruity, trendy criterion.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: Well yeah, so I'd give it a two

events.summary: Speaker A decided on a lithium battery instead of triple A batteries, since triple A needs more than one battery.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: let's just go for a lithium

events.summary: Speaker A confirmed the case is single-curved in the finance sheet.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: It is a single-curved, so one of those

events.summary: Speaker A decided the case material is plastic.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: 'Kay, down here, case material. Plastic.

events.summary: Speaker B said the interface is push-button only, not an integrated scroll wheel, and the side buttons are still push-button.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: We're really having just push-button interface

events.summary: Speaker D proposed three interfaces, one on each side and one on top, which costs less than the scroll option.
events.speaker: D

events.quote: Or three, because of one on each side and one on top

events.summary: Speaker A reported the estimated cost is eleven euros twenty, which is under the twelve euro fifty limit.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Twelve point five is our limit. We've got eleven point two.

events.summary: Speaker B said the design is under the cost limit, so the team can go to production.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So we can go to production

events.summary: Speaker B said the company stifled creativity by restricting the remote to a TV remote at the start.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: restricting us only to using a T_V_ remote, initially

events.summary: Speaker B said the whiteboard did not work, which limited the team's tools.

events.speaker: B
events.quote: The use of the laptops for receiving everything

events.speaker: C

events.summary: Speaker C said marketing has to create the desire for the remote.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: marketing has to actually create the desire for it

events.speaker: B
events.quote: We can create a commercial where they think that all their needs will be met
